reviews.author: Martel Tignor
reviews.text:
I spoke with Steve in person last August about being very proactive with my 2025 taxes. I didn’t hear anything so I emailed a bunch of times, no reply. Called the office in February, got the receptionist, told her this is my first year and maybe I don’t know the routine, but you guys are doing my taxes per an agreement…what do we need to do to make that happen? Got an email in reply from Steve with a link to an Intuit site to upload my documents. Cool. I did that. Weeks go by, silence. I call back to say the documents are uploaded. About a week later, I get an email from Steve(!, same one I’d written to before that got no replies btw) asking for birthdates and last years return. Got that done that moment and replied via email to say so.  9 days ago. Radio silence. Wrote a couple days ago to ask if they’d received the birth information and the requested return. I haven’t heard back.

The take home for me, after reading thru these reviews, is that the office doesn’t communicate very well and if you want your taxes done with this group you need to be a task master and project manage it by calling them often.

Not my style. I’m going to wait until this Friday and if I haven’t heard back I’ll find another accountant. No offense Steve. In person you seem like a decent guy but this is business and I need to make plans that affect other people and I can’t make those plans without some insight into my tax situation.

Update: after I posted the initial review here, I heard from Steve within 2 hours via email. So, if you’d like to get information from him about your tax situation, leave a bad Google review. Worse, Steve did my taxes but evidently did not consult his notes from our initial, only, meeting as he took the house sale and the capital gains issue I proactively spoke with him about last August as exempt from taxation. It is not, as I had explicitly mentioned repeatedly in our August meeting. Unfortunately, I trusted Steve to do his job and signed off on that return because Steve had ask d to look at my previous years taxes to confirm that I wouldn’t owe anything this year. After looking at that, he completed my return. $33 back! Woo-hoo. About a week later I go to do state taxes (he doesn’t automatically do those, btw) and discover that what Steve had done and the return I had filed with the IRS is completely wrong.

I’m now paying a different accountant to do my taxes over and get them right. It is an insane scenario that would have been avoided if Steve had done the job I had asked him to do in August.

Absolutely do not use this accountant. He will find some verbiage or little twist to try and blame other people for the absence if professionalism that reigns in that office, which tells you all you really need to know. I mean, just look at his replies to negative reviews on here.

reviews.author: Mimi Aaron
reviews.text:
My husband normally writes these types of reviews when he feels that businesses he encounters either deserve superior accolades, or deserve equitable criticism. Today, however, I, who almost never writes a review, feels compelled to finally sit down and write about this fabulous CPA firm, Walter Sanders and Associates.

This heartfelt CPA firm has been doing our taxes for 10+ years. At the beginning of each year, my husband and I gather all of our previous year’s financial data, and provide the folks at Walter Sanders and Associates with all that information. These wonderful people take their time to carefully review all of the details on each and every one of our overwhelming and confusing (to us) tax documents, investment statements, donations, expenditures, and more. Then, after a few weeks, once they have made sure all of our accurate and entitled tax deductions are computed, they provide us with a fully developed, neat and completed IRS tax return form.

We are then notified to return to their office to review our computed IRS tax return.  After reviewing, we simply sign the tax return document, and hand them a check for their more than well-deserved fair fee. They then take care of electronically submitting our completed tax return to the IRS that day.

The fact that these fabulous folks at Walter Sanders and Associates are so diligent as well as truly caring and concerned about doing what is in our best interest for our tax financial outcome, makes it a pleasure to have them prepare our tax return every year.

I am writing this review in the hopes that it accomplishes two things: I would like it to provide all the folks at Walter Sanders and Associates with our written sincere gratitude for all they’ve done on our behalf over the years, and I would love to have this review help any possible new clients get an appreciation of how Walter Sanders and Associates wholeheartedly dedicates themselves to their clientele. We honestly feel so very fortunate to have had them guide us and prepare our taxes for more than 10 years.

reviews.author: max hutto
reviews.text: TampTax Accountancy has been preparing my income tax returns for over a decade.  Kathy and her staff are professional, courteous, and above all, very knowledgeable about the old and new tax laws.  She has always gotten me the biggest refunds that the law allows.  And, when I was audited because of an error that I made, Kathy quickly stepped in and made the adjustments needed (no extra charge from TampTax for representing me).  I highly recommend TampTax.    Kathy and her staff are amazing!

reviews.author: Faraz M
reviews.text:
Please please DO NOT even consider this firm as your accountant.
I call Tamptax 4 weeks ago to file my taxes as extension. They scheduled me for Thursday of June 20 which is today. I called them earlier today to confirm my appointment before I show up and someone name Mosy picked up the phone. He had absolutely no idea about my schedule and they had absolutely no information of me in their file. He said that I do not have any appointments scheduled with their firm. Super frustrating after waiting for 4 weeks for my appointment. The worst and most unprofessional accounting firm I have ever experienced in my life.

reviews.author: Katrease James
reviews.text: I have been a loyal customer for over 25 yrs. Since the owner Ms. Kathy let her children take over (her son) it has absolutely been the Worst experience, customer service, the lies etc...... next year I will move my business somewhere else. Obviously they don't appreciate me. It's not so much the IRS delay on my taxes it's the excuses, and the lies that they tell you to get you off the phone and when you follow up like they advise, they tell you the same lie and tell you to follow up in a couple of days. If you want professional service and honesty DO NOT USE THEM FOR ANY SERVICES.

reviews.author: Lori Mills
reviews.text: So glad I started doing my taxes with TampTax. I was filing on my own through free sites and was not getting the return I deserved! They made sure I got everything  back. They were also helpful with information that I needed for my student loan. So glad. I feel like I have a true partner and I am getting the most from my return.

reviews.author: Thenecia Shinholster
reviews.text: I've used Ms. Cole's tax services for several years now and have been very pleased with her knowledge and subsequent results. Like many people, I waited until the 11th hour, but her staff was very friendly and professional, and were able to get me in, and taxes filed on time! I especially like that I was able to get timely copies at a later date. Its important to me that others are respectful of my time, and I wasn't kept waiting for any my appointments. I have recommended them to family and friends.

reviews.author: Ivelisse Rodriguez
reviews.text: I have been filing my taxes with TampTax for 2 years now and have had no issues with their service. COVID has caused many delays with the IRS & throughout that I haven’t needed to worry about my tax returns. Any time I have received any communications from the IRS, I’ve been able to trust TampTax’s team to respond on my behalf or give me the next step I need to move forward. Truly grateful for their services and stress free process!
